AEGIS groups a site's pages into a stack the person can open into one card per page. Presentation only: every page keeps its own id, URL and citations.
A stack's caption carries the control that opens it into one card per page, and stacks it again.
A stack opens into its own cards, which the layout makes room for, instead of fanning over its neighbours on hover.
An AEGIS research run reads left to right from request to report: its first view holds the whole run, down to 29%, instead of cutting off the request at 50%.
